# Thunderbird calendar dialog planning documentation

Category UI is the row/chips MVP: chips are single-line, long labels truncate, two or three show inline, `+x more` exposes remaining categories in a scrollable dialog area without moving or growing it. Verify Bugzilla type/points/dependencies alongside local and Google-plan updates. [Task 5]

Scope: calendar.
